GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Ridden Along 3rd last Two Wide 9 Lengths 800m, was hampered slightly at 500m when horses lost rider and she did lose momentum, widest straightening and gave Leaders a big break but she knuckled down and powered home kin a eye catching display # enormous run
Slow Out 1 Lengths Settled Down 9th fence 8 Lengths 800m 10th 8 Lengths home turn 10th rail made some ground final 200m # back/ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground at the start. Passing the 150m had to be directed in to avoid heels. When questioned, rider stated that he intended settling in a prominent position however, after being slow to begin, the mare failed to muster speed and settled further back in the field. He added that his mount failed to make any appreciable ground in the straight and was disappointing. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back to last 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well # ran on from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

Jumped Fair sat last 9l off, improved turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on well # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Had some difficulty obtaining clear running around the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled last 4-5l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 4l off all clear, running on joined in 100m, headed 50m, kept on strong # had chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT- Option to be ridden conservatively from the wide barrier: Settled at the rear.Began only fairly and then from a wide barrier was shifted behind rnrs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to lead but off fence. led turn. weakened # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the filly, rider advised that his mount travelled well until straightening at which point it did not respond to his riding and proved very disappointing. He advised that he had told connections that the filly may benefit from the addition of blinkers and be dropped back to a 1000m journey for its next start. A post-race veterinary examination of the filly did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to box seat 1 length off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, hit line well without threatening # sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rd stated he was instructed to obtain a prominent position either leading or if other horses showed superior speed to take a trailing position.  He added the filly began well, however, his mnt mustered superior speed in the early stages and, therefore, he was obliged to let that runner cross.  He further added that rounding the home turn he became held up on another rnrs heels and unable to improve and, as he was racing inside the heels of another rnr, he was unable to shift out and remained held up until passing the 200m, where his mnt then finished its race off strong.
